cues: Fixed structure: '1. Classification' (type, dominant constraint, worst failure), then a 'Key decisions (resolved up front)' table with Default and 'Revisit trigger' columns
Phase 0 'first end-to-end slice' that is deployed to production behind a flag with logging, monitoring and a day-zero fallback, then phases ordered by dependency
Each phase has consistent 'Unlocks / Depends on / Tasks (widest first) / Exit check' fields, and tasks are explicitly ordered by widest impact
A cross-cutting concerns matrix (Security/Observability/Reproducibility/Resilience per phase) and '(AI)' tagged decisions with a dedicated AI layer section with exit criteria
A 'Deferred' section with explicit pull-forward triggers, and an explicit note that Phase 0 scaffolding is acceptable only because staff alone see it
